hypothesis: The vtr_event wire format specified in vtr_event.h is interpreted byte-for-byte identically by the Rust EventRecord in src/event/record.rs, including field offsets, endianness, and CRC-32 parameters.
reason_not_confirmed: C-side layout is enforced at compile time via _Static_assert on offsetof and sizeof. Rust-side layout is specified by design. No byte-level cross-language test has been executed. Two independent specifications do not constitute a verified contract.
falsifiers: A byte sequence produced by the C kernel module and parsed by Rust yields a different field value for any of: kind, severity, source_id, pid, ts_delta, or checksum.

CRC-32 computed in C over bytes [0..11] does not match CRC-32 computed in Rust over the same byte sequence with parameters poly=0xEDB88320, init=0xFFFFFFFF, xorout=0xFFFFFFFF, RefIn=true, RefOut=true.
The size_of::<EventRecord>() in Rust does not equal sizeof(vtr_event) in C (expected: 16 bytes on both sides).
Any field offset differs between C offsetof(vtr_event, field) and Rust's computed offset for the equivalent EventRecord field.
confirmation_criteria: A test executable reads a binary blob produced by the C module (captured via hexdump -C on FreeBSD 14.4-RELEASE-p8 / amd64), deserializes it as EventRecord in Rust, and asserts exact field equality for all six fields plus CRC-32 validity. Test passes with SHA-256 of both the blob and the test binary recorded. Test is reproducible from a clean clone.
proposed_experiment: 1. Load vtr_sentinel.ko and trigger a known event (fork of a known process). 2. Capture raw bytes from ring buffer via hexdump -C — record SHA-256 of captured blob. 3. Write a Rust test (cargo test) that deserializes the blob as EventRecord and asserts: size_of::<EventRecord>() == 16, each field value matches expected, CRC-32 over bytes [0..11] matches checksum field. 4. Run test on FreeBSD 14.4-RELEASE-p8 / amd64. Record SHA-256 of test binary. 5. Document pass/fail with full output and timestamp UTC.
required_artifacts: hexdump -C output of captured ring buffer event (SHA-256 recorded)
SHA-256 of vtr_sentinel.ko used in the test
FreeBSD version string (uname -a) at time of test
elevation_path: PROBABLE → CONFIRMED on all falsifiers passing without refutation
refutation_path: Any falsifier triggered → REFUTED, open issue with exact byte diff
